map.根据前列腺体积与术式，设定激光功率、切除镜型号、手术时间及切除组织量预估: Set laser power, resectoscope model, operative time and estimated resected tissue weight based on prostate volume and the procedure type
map.经尿道前列腺电切术(TURP,单极): Transurethral resection of the prostate (TURP, monopolar)
map.经尿道前列腺双极等离子电切(PKRP): Bipolar plasmakinetic resection of the prostate (PKRP)
map.钬激光剜除术(HoLEP): Holmium laser enucleation of the prostate (HoLEP)
map.铥激光剜除术(ThuLEP): Thulium laser enucleation of the prostate (ThuLEP)
map.金标准，需用甘露醇/葡萄糖冲洗，警惕TUR综合征: Gold standard; requires mannitol or glucose irrigation; watch for TUR syndrome
map.生理盐水冲洗，TUR综合征风险低: Saline irrigation, low risk of TUR syndrome
map.汽化为主，出血少，适合抗凝患者: Mainly vaporization, little bleeding, suitable for anticoagulated patients
map.任意体积(大体积优势明显): Any volume (clear advantage for large volumes)
map.剜除+粉碎，组织可病理，无体积上限: Enucleation plus morcellation; tissue available for pathology; no volume limit
map.切割精准，热损伤小，出血少: Precise cutting, minimal thermal damage, little bleeding
map.前列腺<80mL 可选 TURP/双极/PVP；>80mL 首选 HoLEP/T:
For a prostate <80 mL, TURP, bipolar or PVP can be chosen; for >80 mL, HoLEP/ThuLEP enucleation is preferred.
For anticoagulated, elderly or high-risk patients, laser vaporization (PVP) or enucleation is prioritized because of the low bleeding risk. The actual choice must integrate the surgeon's experience and the available equipment.
map.⚠️ 本工具参数仅供手术规划参考，实际参数需术者根据患者情况与设备调整。: ⚠️ The parameters in this tool are for surgical planning reference only; actual parameters must be adjusted by the surgeon according to the patient and the equipment.
map.📚 深度解析：前列腺手术（TURP/激光）参数设定: 📚 Deep dive: prostate surgery (TURP/laser) parameter setting
map.体积 60mL 选双极等离子（PKRP）或 HoLEP；单极 TURP 体积>8: For a volume of 60 mL choose bipolar plasma (PKRP) or HoLEP; monopolar TURP is not recommended above 80 mL because the bleeding risk rises.
map.服抗凝药者优先 HoLEP/ThuLEP（封闭好），围术期按指南停抗凝并用桥接，: Patients on anticoagulants are best served by HoLEP/ThuLEP (better sealing); stop anticoagulants and use bridging perioperatively per guidelines to reduce bleeding.
map.<30mL 可选 TURP/激光，30-80mL 双极或激光，>80mL 剜除术: <30 mL: TURP or laser can be chosen; 30-80 mL: bipolar or laser; >80 mL: enucleation (HoLEP/ThuLEP) is preferable.
map.切除量和手术时间怎么估？: How are the resected weight and operative time estimated?
map.经验上 1 mL 前列腺组织约重 1 g，TURP 平均可按约 1 g/min: As a rule of thumb, 1 mL of prostate tissue weighs about 1 g, and TURP can be estimated at an average resection speed of about 1 g/min, so a 60 mL gland takes about 60 minutes. When the operative time exceeds 90-120 minutes, irrigant absorption increases markedly; TUR syndrome should be watched for and a staged procedure or a switch to enucleation considered.
